pages.title: Forge through a Ruin
pages.text: At the Smithing Table, place Miniature Immortal Ruin as template, Spirit Sword as base, and Spirit Core as addition. The upgrade preserves enchantments and tempering while restoring full durability.

pages.title: A Wider Sword Arc
pages.text: It inherits stage damage, Aura Repair, continuous tempering, and recall. Each point grants 1.5% damage and sweeping reaches 50% farther than a Spirit Sword. Points still halve after a hit.

pages.title: Recall Order
pages.text: If the embedded furnace holds several recallable swords, the most recently used one wins. Recall only changes the held weapon; it neither duplicates the item nor resets its components.

pages.title: Draw Enemies Close
pages.text: Use it to spend 5 Immortal Yuan and move other targets in a 13x13x13 region one block ahead. Velocity is cleared and targets are restrained for 1 second. Server config decides whether players are affected.
